properties.notes: land to become available following the relocation of the present further education college as part of a mixed scheme. Identified in Allocations Plan as an opportunity for mixed development. May be developed on site of former college or part thereof. Site area of total brownfield element is approximately 2.6ha though not all may be available for redevelopment- available area between 0.98 ha and 2.6ha. 2019 update- FoDDC now to purchase site and determine use which may include an element of residential as current allocation.
